zh.title: 美國軍方將在摩洛哥測試自主飛行塞斯納208B急救任務
zh.summary: 美國非洲司令部授予梅林公司50萬美元合約；自主飛行計畫預計2027年進行
body: 美國非洲司令部（AFRICOM）已授予波士頓公司梅林（Merlin）50萬美元合約，開發自主飛行急救任務（CASEVAC）系統，使用塞斯納208B大篷車（Cessna 208B Grand Caravan）在摩洛哥進行測試。
根據梅林說明，該系統可自主完成飛行規劃、導航、應對緊急情況，無需地面站或飛行員。飛機將配備醫療模組，可載運擔架並提供氧氣與監測設備。
此計畫是AFRICOM「自主急救技術挑戰」的首階段，預計於2027年美國財政年度初進行演示，具體時間未明確說明。

en.title: US military to test autonomous Cessna 208B in Morocco for casualty evacuation
en.summary: AFRICOM awards Merlin $500,000 contract; autonomous mission planned for 2027
body: US Africa Command (AFRICOM) has awarded Merlin a $500,000 contract to develop an autonomous casualty evacuation (CASEVAC) system using a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan for testing in Morocco.
Merlin's system handles flight planning, navigation, and contingency response without ground stations or crew. The aircraft will carry a medical module for stretcher transport and patient monitoring.
The demonstration is part of AFRICOM's Autonomous CASEVAC Industry Technology Challenge, scheduled for early 2027 fiscal year.
